newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal CPI seen flat to up 0.2 pct Dec.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal CPI seen flat to up 0.2 pct Dec.

text.p: Analysts forecasts for Portugal's consumer price index (CPI) in December range from unchanged on the previous month to 0.2 percent higher, giving a rolling 12-month average of 3.1 percent.
The year-on-year rate was seen at between 3.2 and 3.4 percent, depending on the month-on-month figure.
In November, the CPI rose 0.2 percent. The National Statistics Institute (INE) is expected the official December figure on December 14 or 15.
In November, the year-on-year rate was three percent and the rolling average, the government's benchmark, 3.1 percent.
The increase in the year-on-year rate in December would be due to statistical reasons because prices fell in the same month last year.
Month-on-month prices fell 0.2 percent in December 1995 when the rolling average was 4.1 percent and the year-on-year rate 3.4 percent.
